author: Brandjuh
name: CuffAffairs
description: Police-themed fun for CuffBot: WANTED posters with the member's photo, officer badges, break-room donuts, 911 citizen reports to the evidence locker, and Papers-Please-style animated citation tickets (cosmetic fines and real warnings).
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store any end user data. It only stores a per-guild log channel id.
install_msg: CuffAffairs installed. Set an evidence locker with `[p]affairsset logchannel #channel` so `[p]911` reports and `[p]cite` copies have somewhere to go.
